benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible dining purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award each year after card renewal, redeemable for a night at a Marriott Bonvoy property with a redemption level at or under 85,000 points.
benefits.terms: Can be topped up with up to 25,000 of the cardholder's own points for a higher-category redemption.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with access to 1,800+ airport lounges worldwide.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to two complimentary guests per visit.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status.
benefits.terms: Automatic with cardmembership by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Annual Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 25 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status tiers each calendar year.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck (5-year membership) application fee.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit is up to $120 (~4-year cycle); TSA PreCheck credit is up to $85 (5-year cycle). Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence; verify against the actual chosen program's renewal date for a given cardholder.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for eligible purchases at The Ritz-Carlton and St. Regis properties on stays of two nights or more.
benefits.terms: Requires minimum 2-night stay booked through eligible channels. Applies per qualifying booking rather than a fixed renewal period.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
